title: Rename a service method, then build a feature on the renamed code
prompt:
Do these two steps in order.

Step 1: rename the method `TaskService.updateStatus` to `TaskService.changeStatus`. Update every caller, every test and every mention in the docs (README.md and docs/) so that nothing in the repository refers to the old name any more.

Step 2: once the rename is done, add `TaskService.reopen(actor, id)`, which moves a `done` task back to `in_progress` by calling `changeStatus`, so the same ownership and transition rules apply. Add a route `POST /tasks/:id/reopen` (no body, authentication and write access like the other task write routes) that responds 200 with the updated task. Reopening a task that is not `done` must respond 409.

Keep `npm test` green.
